note: Cheap-validation implementation proposal (2026-10-05 breadth pass): strict backend/model Clippy and targeted model tests; native GUI compile/render review deferred to the final validation pass.

claims.behavior: The auto-resolution review's approve/deny run four pairs at a time on a worker (ActionAutoResolutionReviewPairs): the button shows 'approving: n/m' while the buttons are disabled, a popup with the same progress appears after four seconds and is finished and dismissed at the end, then the pending list updates and reselects as before (publish_callable).
limits: The reference job is not cancellable either; progress updates between chunks.
